clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or other appropriately authorised specialist named in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding includes NCCP 00900 version 1a. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

indications.description: First-line unresectable or metastatic dMMR/MSI-H colorectal cancer.

treatment.schedule_summary: Nivolumab 240 mg IV then ipilimumab 1 mg/kg IV every 21 days for 4 cycles. Starting 3 weeks after the last combination dose, nivolumab 240 mg IV every 14 days or 480 mg IV every 28 days. Continue until progression, unacceptable toxicity or 24 months, whichever occurs first.

exclusions: Hypersensitivity to a component/excipient; symptomatic interstitial lung disease; pregnancy/breastfeeding.

monitoring: Baseline: FBC, renal and liver profile, blood glucose and thyroid function.
